The company’s valuation could rise to Rs 4,000-4,500 crore from Rs 2,500 crore, driven by rapid topline growth at the company founded by Ankit Chona of the family behind Havmor ice creams.

Private equity firms General Atlantic and ChrysCapital are in discussions with Hocco Ice Cream to invest Rs 300-400 crore in the new-age direct-to-consumer (D2C) brand, according to three people aware of these talks. p: Havmor 아이스크림 가문의 Ankit Chona가 창업한 이 회사는 가파른 매출 성장에 힘입어 기업가치가 2,500억 루피에서 4,000억~4,500억 루피로 상승할 수 있다.
